value.rationale: The precise invariant is the sharp complex L4/L2 geometry of all linear functionals on real ell-p balls, a canonical family from classical Khintchine theory. Its new exact classification identifies a discontinuous optimizer-support change at p=2 (all coordinates to precisely two quadrature-phase coordinates), and determines the full all-dimensional Banach-Mazur profile with explicit stability deficits. These structural statements are useful independently of routine moment evaluation, even without broader applications.
